welcome.title: Welcome to {park}!
paragraphs: This is a real place: Auer Berg 2. Nothing has been made up here: what you see standing is what really stands there, and the gravel tracks are the real ones.

There is no lift, so your guests pedal up the tracks and tire quickly. A T-bar (Build menu) is the first thing to save for: you have just enough money to order one on your own land. Link its valley station to a track with a gravel path (P), or nobody can reach it. Guests arrive on the track at the edge of your land.

1. Hire a worker or two in the Crew menu (C). Your crew builds everything you plan.
2. Press T to draw your first trail: start on a gravel track, wind across the slope and end on a track or lift further down. Press Enter and the crew gets to work.

Steep real slopes rate trails harder, so use switchbacks. Trails and paths may cross brooks and rivers: the crew builds a little bridge, which takes wood. Lakes and houses are in the way. Every trail and feature earns XP. New park levels unlock harder features, more land and bigger lifts. Good luck!
